sign-in.alt: The Open Model Gateway sign-in page: the product name, a Sign in card with the button "Sign in with single sign-on", and a note that signing in alone doesn't give access.

home.alt: Home for Priya Shah: the models she can use, her usage this month (spent, requests, tokens) and her API keys across her workspaces.

workspace-switcher.alt: The workspace selector open, listing the Personal workspace, the Team "Chemistry Teaching" and the Project "Climate Data Study".

admin-overview.alt: Admin Overview: the setup checklist with most steps done and one route still unpriced, and "Platform at a glance" with users, Teams, Projects, ready models, requests and spend this month.

key-create.alt: The Create API key dialog: a name, a service account chosen as the holder, a 90-day expiry, a $50 monthly spending limit, collapsed rate limits, and one selected model.

key-created.alt: The "Save your API key" dialog showing a new key once, with Copy key and I have saved it.

key-detail.alt: An API key's page: its details, spending today, this week and this month, spending over the last 30 days, and a Safety card listing the findings "Expiry too long" and "No budget".

workspace-models.alt: A workspace's Models page: models with their type, input and output prices and serving state, two of them ticked for comparison.

model-compare.alt: Two models compared side by side: prices, context and output ceilings, serving state, and 30 days of requests, error rate, latency, time to first token and speed.

logs-requests.alt: Logs, Requests view: summary tiles for requests, error rate, latency, time to first token and speed above a table of requests with model, key, input and output tokens, cost, latency, finish reason and status.

request-detail.alt: A request's page: the summary and two attempts in order, the first failed on one route and the second succeeded on another, with tokens, timings and cost.

logs-sessions.alt: Logs, Sessions view: requests grouped by session id with request counts, tokens, cost, models and the app name "Course assistant".

usage-overview.alt: Usage and costs overview: spend with the amount on hold, requests, tokens, cache hit rate and cost per million tokens, a daily chart, and top models, keys and members.

usage-explore.alt: The Explore tab: spend grouped by model and then by key, with each group's share of the total and a daily series.

files.alt: The Files page: batch inputs, a batch result and a user file with purpose, size, created and expiry dates, and a storage bar against the workspace's quota.

batch-detail.alt: A batch's page: status and Cancel, the reason it is waiting (At its batch limit), its files, how many lines ended in each state, and tiles for progress, completed and failed lines and the cost so far as a lower bound plus the amount on hold.

notifications.alt: Notifications: a firing budget alert for a Team, a resolved error-rate alert and a personal budget alert, all unread.

workspace-alerts.alt: A Team's alert rules: a budget threshold rule and an error rate rule, one of them firing.

workspace-members.alt: A Team's Members tab: people with their roles and whether each membership is manual or from an SSO group, and a pending invitation.

workspace-limits.alt: A Team's Limits tab: each limit inherited from the platform next to the Team's own tighter values, including a 512 MB storage limit and a daily budget that can only be lowered, and the effective limit.

workspace-settings-visibility.alt: A Team's General settings: its type, role and cost center, and the Files, batches and videos panel with Who sees them set to Per user.

admin-users.alt: Admin Users: people with their platform role, status, last sign-in and number of shared workspaces; someone who signed in without a role shows No access.

admin-user-detail.alt: A user's page in Admin: profile and access, sign-in dates, and a Platform user role granted through an SSO group.

admin-user-detail-actions.alt: A user's page in Admin with its menu open: Grant platform role, Change email, Sign out all sessions, Export user record, Place legal hold, Copy ID and Suspend, beside an Overview showing 3 active sessions.

admin-sso-groups.alt: SSO group mappings: four groups mapped to the Platform user, auditor and admin roles and to membership of the Team "Chemistry Teaching".

admin-team-detail.alt: A Team's page in Admin: its members, available catalogs, models available and cost center.

admin-connections.alt: Admin Connections: a self-hosted vLLM cluster, OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock and OpenRouter, with endpoint or region, status and model counts.

admin-connection-bedrock.alt: The Add connection form for Amazon Bedrock: a region, the Assume role access mode with a role ARN, and an empty VPC endpoint.

admin-models.alt: Admin Models: models of several types with their price, readiness and connection, one needing attention, one not serving and an image model marked Unpriced.

admin-add-model.alt: The Add model form on a self-hosted vLLM connection: connection, upstream model id, type and protocols, display and API model names, catalogs, and an optional first price with its token ceilings and meters.

admin-model-detail.alt: A model's page: two routes with their priority, current price lines and a priority routing policy allowing two attempts.

admin-price-editor.alt: The price editor: input, output and cache read lines, the hard input and output token ceilings, and a separate set of batch prices.

admin-catalogs.alt: Admin Catalogs: three catalogs with their models and who gets them: the Personal, Team and Project defaults and workspaces that chose a catalog themselves.

admin-batch-scheduling.alt: A route's Batch scheduling section: queued lines, running lines, status and server load, above the settings: batch lines at once, yield to live traffic, a server load signal with its limits, a priority hint and a weekday overnight time window.

admin-limits.alt: Defaults and limits for Teams: rate limits, jobs at once, storage and a monthly budget, with tabs for the Personal, Team and Project defaults.

admin-usage.alt: Admin Usage and costs, By workspace: each Team and Project with spend, the amount on hold, requests and attempts with unknown cost, then one totals-only row per personal workspace, named Personal and its owner.

admin-logs.alt: Admin Logs: requests from Teams and Projects with a Workspace column; personal workspaces are not listed.

admin-alerts.alt: Installation alert rules: an admission ceiling, a batch failed, a failing connection, an installation spend and a spend spike rule, two of them firing.

admin-alert-rule.alt: An alert rule's page: a spend spike rule with its factor, minimum amount and recipients, with Cancel and Save.

admin-alert-spend.alt: The Installation spend alert rule: a monthly $25.00 reference amount, alerts at 50, 80 and 100 percent, emailed to Platform Admins and a finance address. It notifies only and never blocks.

admin-alert-ceiling.alt: The Admission ceiling alert rule: the sustained per-workspace or per-key admission rate and lock-wait thresholds that notify Platform Admins.

admin-key-safety.alt: Key safety: tiles counting keys by severity and a personal-keys count, and rows of Team and Project keys with findings such as Expiry too long, Unused and All models.

admin-audit.alt: The Audit log: recent actions with time, actor, action and target, such as changed workspace limits, an uploaded file, placed and released legal holds, a removed membership, SCIM user changes, an invitation and new alert rules.

admin-legal-holds.alt: Admin › Legal holds: two active holds with their reference codes, the person or workspace each applies to, when and by whom each was placed, an Active status and a Release action, with the Include released button above.

admin-settings-general.alt: General settings: the installation's display name, support URL, logo and maximum key lifetime.

admin-settings-privacy.alt: Data and privacy settings: OpenRouter data collection, request log retention, prompt storage, and the Storage card with its backend, encryption key, health and allowed kinds of file.

admin-settings-email.alt: Email settings: an SMTP relay with STARTTLS, a username and password reference, the From address, and a Ready status that has not been tested yet.

admin-settings-sign-in.alt: Sign-in settings: the identity provider configuration and callback URL, signing-key status, and SCIM provisioning status with its base URL.

your-sessions.alt: The Sessions card on Your profile: three sessions with their device (Firefox on macOS marked This browser, Safari on iOS, Chrome on Windows), when each signed in and was last active, Sign out on the other two, and Sign out others.

your-data.alt: The Your data card on Your profile: From and To dates covering the last 30 days, and the Download your data button.

phone-home.alt: Home on a phone: the menu button and Priya Shah's workspaces and models stacked in one column.

admin-settings-audit-export.alt: Admin › Settings › Audit export: the transport (HTTPS webhook) and destination, status Delivering, no events waiting, the last delivery and heartbeat, the next sequence number, and the Send test delivery button.
